people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Yahweh says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’ ”
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: This city will surely be delivered into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.”

translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it.
